backend/main.mo: Motoko actor with a single public function `submitContactForm` that accepts name, email, and message parameters but currently has no implementation (placeholder for future email/notification logic).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the replacement of the Hero component tagline with Sanskrit text 'धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः', listing affected files, components, and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the Sanatani-themed React application with custom styling, routing, components, and pages for the KATTAR SANATANI YODHA organization website.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining light and dark theme color palettes using OKLCH color system, including base styles for borders and body background.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with UTF-8 charset, viewport meta tag, title 'KATTAR SANATANI YODHA', root div, and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router setup defining five routes (Home, About, Programs, Contact, Donate) wrapped in a Layout component, with router provider and TypeScript module declaration.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with four-column grid layout displaying organization logo/info, quick links, contact details with icons, and social media buttons, plus attribution with dynamic year and caffeine.ai link.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with background image overlay, organization name, Sanskrit tagline 'धर्मो रक्षति रक्षितः', mission statement, CTA buttons, and animated scroll indicator.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout wrapper component that renders Navigation header, main content outlet, and Footer for consistent page structure across all routes.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Mission section displaying four core values (Devotion, Protection, Knowledge, Unity) in a responsive grid with icons, titles, and descriptions using card components.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Responsive navigation header with logo, organization name, desktop/mobile menus, active route highlighting, and hamburger menu toggle for mobile devices.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component accepting icon, title, and description props, featuring hover effects and consistent styling for displaying program information.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Grid component displaying four support options (Volunteer, Awareness, Skills, Knowledge) with icons, descriptions, and links to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: React hook that handles contact form submission by calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method and managing submission state (loading, success, error).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity state, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks that interact with the backend; currently contains only commented example structure.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind configuration, custom CSS variables for a Sanatani-inspired color palette (saffron, terracotta, gold), font imports (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), and utility classes for patterns and gradients.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: About page component displaying the organization's story, purpose, vision, values, and community principles with a hero section and grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page component with a form using useContactForm hook, contact information display, and social media links for reaching the organization.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donate page component showing support options, impact areas with percentage breakdowns, and transparency commitment for the organization's mission funding.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page component featuring a hero section, mission statement, 'What We Do' highlights grid with four focus areas (Cultural Preservation, Spiritual Education, Community Building, Social Service), and a call-to-action section with donate and contact buttons.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Programs page displaying six program cards (Vedic Study Circles, Cultural Festivals, Youth Education, Community Gatherings, Social Welfare, Heritage Preservation) with a hero section, programs grid, and impact statistics section showing community metrics.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH color system, Sanatani-themed colors (saffron, terracotta, gold), custom font families (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), warm shadow utilities, and custom animations for accordions and fade-in effects.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file documenting completed features for the KATTAR SANATANI YODHA non-profit website, including homepage, about section, programs, contact form, donate section, cultural theming, logo integration, and tagline updates.
